newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks decline at open, tech stocks weigh.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks decline at open, tech stocks weigh.

text.p: Wall Street shares declined at the market open on Tuesday, adding to Monday's losses, as the technology sector came under selling pressure.
The Dow Jones industrial average was off around 21 points at 7267, while the Nasdaq composite, heavily weighted with technology stocks, shed around 13 points to trade at 1391.

Seagate Technology Inc was high on the list of active stocks on the New York Stock Exchange, off 4-1/4 at 38-1/8. On Monday, the disk drive maker said its quarterly earnings would be below estimates. Networking stocks were also weaker after similiar news from Cabletron Systems.
